value.message: Town of Oakville runs Learn to Swim preschool levels this fall, with kids needing the right age by the start date - their site says fall registration opened Aug 11 at 7am, though day, time and price weren't on the page I saw. I couldn't get into the full schedule today, so I'll keep looking and text you what it says, plus what YMCA of Oakville and Goldfish Swim School - Oakville have for preschoolers.
